title: Ingles Markets, Incorporated Reports Results for Third Quarter and First Nine Months of Fiscal 2026
summary: ASHEVILLE, N.C., August 06, 2026--Ingles Markets, Incorporated (NASDAQ: IMKTA) today reported results for the three and nine months ended June 27, 2026.

title: Ingles Markets, Incorporated Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
summary: ASHEVILLE, N.C., June 29, 2026--Ingles Markets, Incorporated (NASDAQ: IMKTA) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.165 (sixteen and one-half cents) per share on all its Class A Common Stock and $0.15 (fifteen cents) per share on all its Class B Common Stock. This is an annual rate of $0.66 and $0.60 per share, respectively. Dividends on both the Class A and Class B Common Stock are payable July 16, 2026, to all shareholders of record on July 9, 2026.
